title: Omar0Rawas/bayn
summary: Offline EEG event capture aimed at absence seizures in children: a Muse 2 trigger saves the EEG, transcribes what was said (Arabic/English, Whisper) and writes a local LLM summary. Hackathon prototype, not a medical device.

title: rigspark/rigspark
summary: Run local AI on your own computer: chat, images, video and voice with open LLMs like Llama, Qwen and Gemma. Checks which models fit your RAM and GPU before you download. Free, open source (MIT), no account.

title: topunix/django-explain-errors
summary: 🐍 Django middleware that explains unhandled exceptions in DEBUG using an LLM, optionally grounded in your own project source via a local vector index. Works with OpenAI, Claude, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint including local models.

title: khannoussi-malek/PaperLab
summary: Local-first PDF reader for researchers: notes anchored to the page, AI answers that cite it. Runs offline with Ollama.

title: VitruvianSoftware/nexus-agent
summary: A macOS menu bar app and Telegram bot bridging your messages to local AI coding CLI tools, giving you remote access to agentic capabilities from any device.

title: aisixteen/fantastic
summary: A medium that unifies humans and AIs into a single workspace: a kernel where models, programs, files, shells and a live canvas are all agents, reached by one call.

title: ldbumble/taskuary
summary: Your AI work partner. Mail, chats and tickets become one list in the right order; your agents do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Free, open source, runs on your computer.

title: lidge-jun/opencodex
summary: Universal provider proxy for OpenAI Codex & Claude Code — use any LLM (Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Ollama…) with Codex CLI, App, SDK, and Claude Code

title: mario-andreschak/FLUJO
summary: Multi-Agent + Automation Harness: Graph-based Workflows, MCP, Self-Improving Agents. NextJs+React

title: jeancodeeer/JeanCode
summary: Open-source AI coding agent for your desktop: edits code, runs commands, checks its own errors and can operate your PC. Bring any model: Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, Groq and 28 OpenAI-compatible providers, or your own free API.

title: CherryHQ/cherry-studio
summary: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.

title: rjcuff/Woolly
summary: One memory for all your AI tools. Local, private, and always up to date. Works with Claude, Cursor, Ollama and any MCP app.

title: open-webui/open-webui
summary: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)

title: webaesbyamin/agent-receipts
summary: Signed receipts for the work your AI agent does. MCP server, SDK, CLI, dashboard and Magic Folder. Verify offline. Local-first, MIT.

title: olaf-wilkosz/usage-tracker-for-ollama-cloud
summary: Unofficial browser extension that shows your Ollama Cloud usage, credits and activity. Uses the official Ollama API. No telemetry.

title: canoo/agent-nexus
summary: Multi-model agentic orchestration framework — route tasks to cloud or local LLMs, manage personas, and configure everything through an interactive TUI.

title: maxk2222/loom
summary: LOOM — LLM Orchestration & Operations Mesh: centrally-managed, decentrally-executed inference pooling for research workstations (Rust + React)

title: OnurByte/Tehom
summary: Local-first, native Rust video clipping with GPUI. Under development.

title: 14manj01/camsentry-mcp
summary: Unofficial read-only MCP server that lets a local model watch Wyze cameras, remember what they saw and text you when something matters. Vision stays on your machine.

title: Wulfgardr/mediflow
summary: Gestionale gratuito e a codice aperto per cartelle cliniche, documenti e attività ambulatoriali. Utilizzabile anche senza intelligenza artificiale.
